name: Maline
source:
Once upon a time in hell...

Immerse yourself in the zany and heartfelt story of Maline, a kind devil girl from Hell who discovers the true power of Kindness one day by giving a generic demon a compliment... and the chance to truly make everyone friends! Is this a dream come true, or just another demonic swindle?

♡ Find out in the riveting, storybook-inspired adventure of "Maline!" ♡

This game serves as the prequel to SUPER UNDERWRLD, the action-adventure game currently in development.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652660/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
曾几何时，在地狱…

让自己沉浸在Maline的滑稽而真挚的故事中，她是一位来自地狱的善良恶魔女孩，有一天，她通过赞美一个普通的恶魔，发现了善良的真正力量……并有机会真正与每个人成为朋友！这是梦想成真，还是又一场邪恶的骗局？

♡ 在引人入胜、受故事书启发的冒险“Maline”中找到答案！♡

该游戏是目前正在开发的动作冒险游戏SUPER UNDERWRLD的前传。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652660/]Steam[/url]]
